description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the RegistrationEventQueueDao, testing registration event queue data access operations such as retrieval and saving of registration events within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueueDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that verifies the behavior of RegistrationEventQueueDao methods related to registration event queue operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures before each test, including loading configuration data and creating an instance of RegistrationEventQueueDao.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationEventByType
methods.description: Tests retrieving registration events by type and verifies the correctness of the returned data.

methods.name: testGetUnpublishedRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Tests fetching multiple unpublished registration events with specified batch sizes and verifies the count and correctness of data.

methods.name: testSaveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Tests saving a registration event to the database and verifies that the saved data matches the input data.
